metadata.description: Trainnr AI's plugins for coding agents.

plugins.name: trainnr
plugins.description: The physical AI platform for robot training, run from your coding agent: data collection and telemetry, real-to-sim system identification, simulation, synthetic data, reinforcement and imitation learning, evaluation, sim-to-real deployment, and the data flywheel back into training. One MCP server, the Studio (downloaded on first use), seven agents and two skills.
